scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@forge-org/tokens && npm run build --workspace=@forge-org/icons && npm run build --workspace=@forge-org/ui && npm run build --workspace=@forge-org/api-client
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@forge-org/web
scripts.test: npm run check:architecture && npm run check:design-system && npm run check:tokens && npm run check:api-types && npm run typecheck && npm run test:architecture && npm run test:ui && npm run test:packages
scripts.test:packages: npm run build --workspace=@forge-org/tokens && npm run build --workspace=@forge-org/icons && npm test --workspace=@forge-org/tokens && npm test --workspace=@forge-org/ui && npm test --workspace=@forge-org/icons && npm run test:contract --workspace=@forge-org/api-client && node --test tooling/scripts/package-consumer.test.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --project apps/api --locked ruff format apps/api/src apps/api/tests && cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/desktop/Cargo.toml && cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && uv run --project apps/api --locked ruff format --check apps/api/src apps/api/tests && cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/desktop/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:python && npm run lint:rust
scripts.lint:python: uv run --project apps/api --locked ruff check apps/api/src apps/api/tests
scripts.lint:rust: cargo clippy --all-targets --manifest-path apps/desktop/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --all-targets --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings
scripts.lint:fix: prettier --write . && eslint . --fix && uv run --project apps/api --locked ruff check --fix apps/api/src apps/api/tests && uv run --project apps/api --locked ruff format apps/api/src apps/api/tests && cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/desktop/Cargo.toml && cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.quality: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
